paragraphs: KPA sells compliance help to automotive businesses, combining Vera Suite software, consulting, and training across EHS, HR, and FTC regulations. The buyers named throughout the site are dealerships, collision centers, and auto care facilities.

The approach brings together compliance technology, 150 local consultants, and a training library. Vera Suite is offered as one login covering every compliance area, replacing patchwork systems and manual tracking. On the safety side, the tools handle trackable issue management, QR code access to facility-specific Safety Data Sheets, and environmental testing. Consultants add quarterly onsite visits. A separate line handles cybersecurity and data privacy, simplifying compliance for MFA, DSARs, cookie banners, and more. A third covers advertising, sales and finance and insurance work, with an advertising archive, mystery shopping of website leads, and deal jacket analysis.

The company traces its consulting work back to 1986. It states that clients completed over 3 million courses in the past year. Customers span franchise auto groups, RV dealerships, and truck, motorsports, motorcycle, or marine dealerships.

quote.text: Compliance is complex. KPA makes it manageable with Vera Suite software, consulting, and training across EHS, HR, and FTC regulations.
